resolved.Name: S3
resolved.Title: hard kill under load (3 cycles)
resolved.Description: The gateway process is hard-killed (SIGKILL on Linux, TerminateProcess on Windows) at 60s, 120s and 180s and restarted 10 s later each time, on the same data dir. Requests during the outage fail at the client and are not in the promised set. Replay after each restart may duplicate up to about one checkpoint interval of events on non-idempotent sinks (archive raw, webhook raw); siem must store none. kill -9 is not power loss: the page cache survives.

ExtraChecks.Note: duplicates carry the same idem key

notes: kill = SIGKILL; graceful stop = SIGTERM. kill -9 is not power loss (page cache survives).
